@@U00327@@
What’s your name?

@@U00329@@
Id call that a rather petty question, especially from one with such contempt for words, who scorns appearance and digs down deep for the core of things.

@@U00331@@
The essence of the likes of you, sir, can usually be read in their name, Lord of the Flies, say, or Destroyer, Liar. It’s really quite transparent. So, then, who are you?

@@U00333@@
A part of the Power that always wills evil, but always works the good.

@@U00335@@
What is this riddle?

@@U00337@@
I’m the spirit that always negates! And rightly so, since all that is deserves to perish. How much better if nothing ever existed. And therefore, all that you call sin, destruction, in a word, evil, is my proper element.

@@U00339@@
A part, you say? You call yourself a part, and yet you stand there as whole as can be?
translation:
@@U00327@@
你叫什么名字？

@@U00329@@
我认为这是一个相当琐碎的问题，尤其是对于一个如此蔑视言语、蔑视表象并深入挖掘事物核心的人来说。

@@U00331@@
先生，像您这样的人的本质通常可以从他们的名字中读出，比如“蝇王”，或者“毁灭者，骗子”。它确实非常透明。那么，你是谁？

@@U00333@@
力量的一部分总是想作恶，但总是行善。

@@U00335@@
这是什么谜语？

@@U00337@@
我是永远否定的精神！这是正确的，因为一切都应该灭亡。如果什么都不存在该多好。因此，所有你所说的罪恶、毁灭，总之，邪恶，都是我的固有元素。

@@U00339@@
你说一部分？你称自己为一部分，但你却尽可能完整地站在那里？
